query:
Compile the distributed Aurora application-fee and review-time rules into a reusable Python function. It must handle normal and expedited applications from approved nonprofits and other applicants. Account for every fee rule and the review-time override.
The answer string must contain only a Python function named application_quote(application_count, approved_nonprofit, expedited), without Markdown fences or imports. Return a tuple (total_fee_eur, review_business_days). application_count is a positive integer; the other inputs are booleans. The total fee is the per-application fee multiplied by application_count. Use only the policy rules and respect its exception. Create exactly one cited factual claim for each of these source facts, using 'field: value' claim strings: standard_fee_eur, nonprofit_fee_percent, standard_review_days, expedited_review_days, nonprofit_review_days. Use numeric values, preserve exact source citations, and return the required JSON object with answer, claims and unknowns.
raw_answer:
{"answer":"def application_quote(application_count, approved_nonprofit, expedited):
    per_application_fee = 120
    if approved_nonprofit:
        per_application_fee = per_application_fee * 25 // 100
        review_business_days = 14
    else:
        review_business_days = 5 if expedited else 20
    return (per_application_fee * application_count, review_business_days)","claims":[{"claim":"standard_fee_eur: 120","citations":[{"document_id":"aurora-policy","source_sha256":"08491cac1c2729b3d30ff1709cd4029f4253b39724b5b92a381bcaed6419934d","page":3,"start":2156,"end":2206,"quote":"Rule F1. The standard application fee is EUR 120.
"}]},{"claim":"nonprofit_fee_percent: 25","citations":[{"document_id":"aurora-policy","source_sha256":"08491cac1c2729b3d30ff1709cd4029f4253b39724b5b92a381bcaed6419934d","page":14,"start":2157,"end":2236,"quote":"Rule F2. An approved nonprofit pays 25% of the standard application fee in F1.
"}]},{"claim":"standard_review_days: 20","citations":[{"document_id":"aurora-policy","source_sha256":"08491cac1c2729b3d30ff1709cd4029f4253b39724b5b92a381bcaed6419934d","page":5,"start":2156,"end":2280,"quote":"Rule T0. Standard review takes 20 business days.
Rule T1. An expedited application is normally reviewed in 5 business days.
"}]},{"claim":"expedited_review_days: 5","citations":[{"document_id":"aurora-policy","source_sha256":"08491cac1c2729b3d30ff1709cd4029f4253b39724b5b92a381bcaed6419934d","page":5,"start":2156,"end":2280,"quote":"Rule T0. Standard review takes 20 business days.
Rule T1. An expedited application is normally reviewed in 5 business days.
"}]},{"claim":"nonprofit_review_days: 14","citations":[{"document_id":"aurora-policy","source_sha256":"08491cac1c2729b3d30ff1709cd4029f4253b39724b5b92a381bcaed6419934d","page":22,"start":2157,"end":2279,"quote":"Exception T2. Approved nonprofit applications take 14 business days, including expedited applications; this overrides T1.
"}]}],"unknowns":[]}
